ns2:section.sectionText: Individuals registering for a Monday lab section must register for a Thursday discussion section. Individuals registering for a Wednesday lab section must register for a Friday discussion section. Those registering for a Tuesday lab section can register for either a Thursday or Friday discussion. Enrollment in this course is restricted by major. If your program requires this course and you are unable to register for a lecture, contact Deb Bielser at bielser@life.uiuc.edu for more information.
